code: rv = match(ms, ml.magic, ml.nmagic, s, nbytes, offset + o, mode, text, flip, indir_count, name_count, printed_something, need_separator, returnval);
note: In the FILE_USE case, rv is assigned the return value of match(). If match() returns without setting rv on all paths (e.g., when the magic list is empty or the loop body never executes), rv remains uninitialized and is later used in the comparison 'if (rv != 1)'.
The local variable rv is declared without initialization in match(). Depending on control flow, rv may be used before being assigned, leading to a use-of-uninitialized-value.

check_fmt() initializes rv = -1, but this is a separate function. In match(), if the FILE_USE path is taken and the inner match() call does not assign rv on all paths, the uninitialized rv from mget() is used in the comparison, triggering MSAN.

The uninitialized rv value is read in this comparison. This is the memory-safety sink where MSAN reports the use-of-uninitialized-value when a crafted input triggers the FILE_USE path with a magic entry that causes match() to return without initializing rv.
